title: glassbrain profile (_profile.json)
description: The declarative part of a glassbrain profile, as a `_profile.json` next to the graph files. Everything is optional: with no profile a graph still renders (kinds without a color are drawn as skeleton). Parsers, merge and domain validation are code and live in a TypeScript profile instead.

layers.description: Layers for the 2.5D plane view. One default layer if omitted.

structural.description: false = placed around the main structure instead of taking part in it.

nodePalette.description: Node kind → color. Kinds not listed are skeleton.

placeholderFlags.description: Nodes with any of these flags are drawn as placeholders (declared, not yet filled).

kindLabels.description: Kind → human-readable name (nodes and edges share this map).

edgeLabels.description: Same as kindLabels, for edge kinds; merged into it.

style.description: Extra cytoscape style rules, appended after the base style.

singleRoot.description: Wrap several top-level nodes in one root box (default true).

diffIgnore.description: Node fields that do not count as a change when diffing (fields every rebuild rewrites, e.g. cluster ids or line numbers). Used by the glassbrain CLI.
